Developer Guide for metabr

Source: DEVELOPER.md

Welcome to the developer guide for metabr (v0.2.4), an R package designed for metabolite data ingestion, quality control (QC) batch correction, normalization, and curation discrepancy analysis for metabolomics data (Kibbey Lab / Attie Lab systems genetics).

This document details package architecture, data models, developer environment setup, core QC batch-correction algorithms, S3 class definitions, and verification procedures.

1. Ecosystem & Package Architecture

metabr serves as the metabolite data ingestion and standardization layer. It takes raw peak-area spreadsheets output by El-MAVEN or LC-MS platforms, applies quality control sample batch corrections across runs, plates, and batches, and outputs standardized datasets for downstream analysis.

Key R Functions & Modules

Module / File Core Functions Description
R/qc_steps.R qc_steps(), calc_cf(), replace_missing_ave_cf(), correct_raw_cf() Core quality control batch-correction engine using plate QC pool sample ratios
R/read_raw_metab.R read_raw_metab() Ingests raw LC-MS peak-area tables; parses traits and sample identifiers (mouse_id, run, rundate, Batch, Plate, time, rep)
R/read_batch_metab.R read_batch_metab() Parses previously batch-corrected multi-sheet Excel files
R/read_metab.R read_metab_minute() Ingests minute-specific time-course metabolomics experiments
R/write_metab.R write_metab() Exports long-format metabolite tibbles into standardized wide CSV files
R/norm_merge.R normalize() Applies compound-wise mean-centering and log⁡2\log_2 transformation
R/hand_auto.R hand_auto(), ggplot_hand_auto(), autoplot.hand_auto() S3 class and ggplot methods to compare manual vs. automated curation ratios

2. Developer Environment & Setup

Prerequisites

  • R Version: ≥3.5.0\ge 3.5.0
  • Core Dependencies: dplyr, ggplot2, knitr, readr, purrr, stringr, tibble, tidyr, utils, readxl, rlang
  • Optional Suggests: EnrichmentBrowser, OmnipathR

Development Workflow

# 1. Load active package development session
devtools::load_all()

# 2. Update roxygen2 documentation & NAMESPACE
devtools::document()

# 3. Run package check
devtools::check(cran = FALSE)

[!NOTE] All Git operations (status, diff, branch, checkout, staging, commit, push) are reserved for the user to execute manually.

3. Core Quality Control Methodology

The core pipeline operation in metabr is plate-level quality control (QC) batch correction driven by qc_steps().

Mathematical Correction Formula

For a given compound cc (and retention time medRt\text{medRt} for untargeted assays) measured in batch bb and plate pp:

  1. Calculate Plate QC Mean: y‾b,p,c,QC=1NQC∑i∈QCb,pyi,c\bar{y}_{b, p, c, \text{QC}} = \frac{1}{N_{\text{QC}}} \sum_{i \in \text{QC}_{b,p}} y_{i, c}

  2. Calculate Global Compound QC Mean: y‾c,QC=1Ntotal QC∑all QCyi,c\bar{y}_{c, \text{QC}} = \frac{1}{N_{\text{total QC}}} \sum_{\text{all QC}} y_{i, c}

  3. Correction Factor (CF): CFb,p,c=y‾b,p,c,QCy‾c,QC\text{CF}_{b, p, c} = \frac{\bar{y}_{b, p, c, \text{QC}}}{\bar{y}_{c, \text{QC}}}

  4. Batch-Corrected Sample Intensity: ycorrected,i=yraw,iCFb,p,cy_{\text{corrected}, i} = \frac{y_{\text{raw}, i}}{\text{CF}_{b, p, c}}

If a plate QC mean is missing for a compound, replace_missing_ave_cf() computes the average correction factor across available plates to prevent missingness propagation.

4. Analysis & Diagnostic Workflows

The repository includes several analysis workflows and vignette notebooks:

  • QC_Automation.Rmd: Unified, parameterized QC batch-correction pipeline configurable by batch date (params$batch_date).
  • QC_Automation_2023.Rmd: Historical benchmark on Founder Plasma validating automated correction against human curation (hand_auto()).
  • QC_Automation_2025.Rmd: Automated batch correction on Diversity Outbred (DO) liver tissues.
  • QC_steps.Rmd: Detailed step-by-step walkthrough of QC pool calculations and correction factors.
  • QC_check.Rmd: Diagnostic verification of batch correction outcomes.
  • elmaven.Rmd: Peak-area table parsing and El-MAVEN output structure evaluation.
